Official API property description:
Ascott Makati offers luxury serviced apartments in the very heart of Makati, Manila's premier financial and lifestyle district. Strategically situated within the prestigious Ayala Centre, our residence provides direct access to Glorietta Mall, putting you effortlessly within moments of upscale shopping, modern office buildings, and a diverse selection of first-class restaurants and bistros. This prime location ensures you are supremely well-connected to major multinational companies, international banks, and foreign embassies, establishing an ideal base for both international business executives and discerning leisure travellers seeking an extended stay in the capital.

Each spacious serviced apartment is thoughtfully designed for uncompromising comfort and residential convenience, featuring elegant, contemporary furnishings that create a sophisticated atmosphere. Choose from a range of accommodation options, from well-appointed studios perfect for solo professionals or couples, to expansive three-bedroom apartments ideal for families or groups. Every residence is crafted for independence, equipped with en-suite bathrooms, a fully fitted kitchen complete with a cooker hob, microwave, refrigerator, and essential utensils, alongside the added benefit of in-suite washing machines and dryers. This empowers you to maintain an authentic, luxury home-away-from-home experience.

Guests at Ascott Makati benefit from a comprehensive, exclusive array of facilities designed to enhance their stay and well-being. Maintain your fitness routine at our modern on-site fitness centre, enjoy a refreshing dip in the inviting outdoor swimming pool, or engage in leisure on the tennis courts. For moments of pure relaxation and rejuvenation, the Paradasia Royale Spa offers a selection of soothing treatments. Business travellers will appreciate our well-appointed meeting and conference rooms, professional business centre services, and reliable broadband internet access throughout the property. Mesclun, our on-site restaurant, provides a delightful daily breakfast.

We are committed to providing a seamless and secure residential experience. Our dedicated team is on hand 24 hours a day to assist with your needs, from comprehensive security and electronic key card access to efficient laundry and dry-cleaning services. For added convenience, airport transfers and secure car parking with an electric vehicle charging station are provided. We are also a pet-friendly property, welcoming your beloved companions with applicable fees and advance notification. Finally, reflecting our dedication to sustainability and excellence, Ascott Makati now runs on 100% renewable energy and was proudly named Philippines' Leading Serviced Apartments 2025 by the World Travel Awards.

Ascott Clean360
Ascott Makati has implemented the Ascott Clean360 commitments, whcih demonstrates Ascott’s Duty of Care by providing a safe and comfortable home for you and a safe and conducive working environment for our associates. More info here.

Ascott Cares Hygiene Excellence and Safety Label
Ascott Makati received the acclaimed Ascott Cares Hygiene Excellence and Safety Label by Bureau Veritas (BV). A world leader in testing, inspection and certification services, BV conducted field audits at the property to ensure that the nine commitments under Ascott Cares met the stringent requirements of BV’s inspection programme.

To experience the pulsating energy of one of the world's most populated cities, one should pay Makati a visit. One of Metro Manila’s 17 districts, Makati makes up the very core of the National Capital Region of the Philippines.

Located in what is known as the ‘Ayala Triangle’, a posh, upscale area comprising upscale shopping malls, modern office buildings, first-class restaurants, bistros and bars, is the luxurious Ascott Makati residence. The serviced apartments are spacious and elegantly furnished with contemporary furniture, encapsulating the very idea of sophisticated global living.

Official apartment hub title: Serviced Apartment Residence in Manila

Official apartment hub description:
At the end of an exciting day, retire to the luxury residence to rejuvenate. Ascott Makati offers global travellers the comforts and little lavishes that makes us their home of choice away from home.


The serviced apartments are spacious and elegantly furnished with contemporary furniture, encapsulating the very idea of sophisticated global living. Apartments come in various sizes, ranging from studios to three-bedroom apartments that come fitted with a well-equipped kitchen for those to enjoy preparing their own meals, a washing machine and dryer, and floor-to-ceiling windows boasting exceptional views of the city.


In addition, each apartment is fitted with an LCD television complete with a home theatre system, en-suite bathrooms, workstation, individually controlled air conditioning, daily housekeeping and complimentary Wi-Fi connectivity.

Official location page description:
Located in the vibrant heart of Makati, Ascott Makati places you at the centre of Metro Manila’s commercial and cultural core. Ideally set in the renowned Ayala Centre and within walking distance of the Ayala Triangle, our residence ensures immediate access to luxury shopping, sophisticated office buildings, and first-class restaurants and bistros. Guests enjoy direct access to Glorietta Mall and proximity to The Landmark, Greenbelt, and Power Plant shopping malls, all within effortless reach.

The immediate neighbourhood offers abundant cultural and leisure pursuits. For a touch of local culture and history, the Ayala Museum is just a brief walk away, showcasing notable Filipino art and historical exhibits. Furthermore, the Ayala Triangle Gardens offer a serene green space amid the urban hustle, ideal for a contemplative stroll. This strategic positioning, coupled with excellent transport links, ensures every aspect of the Makati lifestyle, from high-level business engagements to sophisticated leisure, is instantly accessible.

Official Getting to property:
From Ninoy Aquino International Airport (NAIA):

- By taxi/private transfer: The journey typically takes around 25 to 45 minutes, depending on traffic. Airport transfers can be arranged through our concierge for a smooth, executive journey.

- By Premium Public Transport: UBE Express P2P Buses regularly connect NAIA Terminal 3 to the nearby One Ayala Terminal (a short walk from the residence), offering an affordable and efficient premium transfer option that typically takes 40 to 60 minutes.

Official nearest public transport:
- Ayala Metro Station (MRT-3 Line): Conveniently located just a short 5-minute walk from our residence, providing direct access to the wider district and efficient connectivity across Metro Manila.

- One Ayala Terminal: The newly opened terminal offers a comprehensive network of bus routes, including P2P services, enhancing your urban connectivity.
